svg.title: Lotka–Volterra sampled state cloud around the equilibrium
svg.desc: Seeded control-history samples form an orbit around the unforced equilibrium. Dots and convex sample hulls are illustrative, not certified reachable sets.
svg.text: A controlled orbit, seen through sampled histories
60-step discrete recurrence · 512 seeded control sequences · sample geometry only
Each dot is one evaluated state from a sampled history; missing histories are possible.
Dashed outlines are hulls of displayed samples only.
They are not inner or outer reachability certificates.
Orbit view has shared axes; stage panels use local zooms.
